title: 〜をめぐって
meaning: surrounding, concerning, about [/ focusing on / in connection with]

meaning_notes.text: [〜] を中心点にして、どんな議論や対立関係が起こっているかを言う時
meaning_notes.html: [〜] を中心点にして、どんな議論や対立関係が起こっているかを言う時

sections.body_text:
surrounding, concerning, about [/ focusing on / in connection with] 
 There is much debate "concerning...etc" ......X 
 [〜] を中心点にして、どんな議論や対立関係が起こっているかを言う時
sections.body_html:
surrounding, concerning, about [/ focusing on / in connection with]

examples.japanese: この規則の改正をめぐって、まだ討論が続いている。

translations.text: The debate about [concerning] the revision of this regulation is still continuing.
translations.html: The debate about [concerning] the revision of this regulation is still continuing.

segments.text: The debate about [concerning] the revision of this regulation is still continuing.

examples.japanese: 土地の利用をめぐって、二つの対立した意見が見られる。

translations.text: There are two conflicting opinions about [concerning] the use of this land.
